svg.title: Athar concept-learning visual targets: six native Android screens
svg.desc: New design reference, not screenshots of the existing app. Six 390 by 844 logical-pixel screens show Learn, a concept card, selected practice, visible incorrect feedback, correct application feedback and completion. Original forest-green book companions have eyes, mouths and detached hands and feet. Sample content is a neutral map-skills demo. Runtime motion and accessibility requirements are specified in the corrective brief.

text.tspan: A learning journey you can see and feel.
Implementation target · neutral English demo · 1 November 2026
A clear path and a useful next step.
In this map, a blue line
The map key tells you that.
Read, then try one easy question.
Teach briefly; keep source access available.
Selection has depth; correctness comes later.
A battery level belongs to a device.
The outcome, why and next action stay visible.
Read the key for that map.
Assume every line is a river.
Each map’s key explains its symbols.
You used the idea in a new situation.
Feedback celebrates the idea, not guessed mastery.
A book celebration and an honest next step.
Original Athar vector artwork. Adapt to native insets, large text and assistive technology; the brief defines live motion and behaviour.
